Definition: from a presumed compound of G4862 and G3401; a co-imitator, i.e. fellow votary:--follower together.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells the Philippians to be followers together of him, and to mark those who walk as he does. He does not ask them to imitate him alone but to imitate him together, so that the whole church learns the same walk from the same example.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe following Christ is something we do together, and I hold that a church that follows its godly examples together will not drift apart.
